greeting_1_zh.text: 晚上好，欢迎来到牌桌。我是阿斯特丽德，您随便坐。
greeting_1_zh.engelska: Good evening, and welcome to the table. I'm Astrid, take any seat you like.

greeting_2_zh.text: 欢迎光临。请坐，牌都是新的，这张桌子归您了。
greeting_2_zh.engelska: Welcome in. Pull up a chair, the cards are fresh and the table is yours.

greeting_3_zh.text: 牌桌上来了新朋友。欢迎，我是阿斯特丽德，今晚由我为您发牌。
greeting_3_zh.engelska: A new face at the table. Welcome, I'm Astrid, and I'll be dealing for you tonight.

placebets_1_zh.text: 开始下注。您准备好了就请放筹码。
placebets_1_zh.engelska: Bets are open. Place your chips whenever you're ready.

placebets_2_zh.text: 新的一局，新的牌。下注区归您了。
placebets_2_zh.engelska: New round, fresh cards. The betting circle is all yours.

placebets_3_zh.text: 牌桌开放了。不用着急，请下注。
placebets_3_zh.engelska: The table is open. Take your time, and place your bets.

goodluck_1_zh.engelska: No more bets. Here come the cards.

goodluck_2_zh.engelska: Bets are closed. Good luck, everyone.

goodluck_3_zh.text: 下注结束。看看牌靴给我们准备了什么。
goodluck_3_zh.engelska: That's all the bets. Let's see what the shoe has for us.

sidebet_1_zh.text: 您的边注中了，马上赔付。
sidebet_1_zh.engelska: Your side bet comes in. That one pays straight away.

sidebet_2_zh.text: 边注赢了。这一手开得真不错。
sidebet_2_zh.engelska: Side bet's a winner. Nice way to start the hand.

sidebet_3_zh.text: 边注中了。还没开始就先赢了。
sidebet_3_zh.engelska: And the side bet lands. Paid before we've even begun.

insurance_1_zh.text: 我的明牌是A。有人要买保险吗？
insurance_1_zh.engelska: Ace showing. Would anyone like insurance?

insurance_2_zh.text: 我的明牌是A。现在可以买保险，保险二赔一。
insurance_2_zh.engelska: I have an ace. Insurance is open, and it pays two to one.

insurance_3_zh.text: 明牌是A，所以可以买保险。完全由您决定。
insurance_3_zh.engelska: Ace up, so insurance is on offer. Entirely your call.

double_1_zh.engelska: Doubling down. One card, and one card only.

double_2_zh.text: 好的，加倍。这是您的一张牌。
double_2_zh.engelska: Double it is. Here's your one card.

double_3_zh.engelska: Doubled. One card to settle it.

bust_1_zh.text: 很遗憾，超过二十一点了。这手牌结束了。
bust_1_zh.engelska: Over twenty-one, I'm afraid. That hand is done.

bust_2_zh.text: 爆牌了。这张牌运气不好。

bust_3_zh.text: 点数太多了，抱歉。这一手归庄家。
bust_3_zh.engelska: Too many, I'm sorry. That one goes to the house.

blackjack_1_zh.text: 黑杰克！打得漂亮。三赔二。
blackjack_1_zh.engelska: Blackjack! Beautifully done. That pays three to two.

blackjack_2_zh.text: 一发牌就是黑杰克。三赔二。
blackjack_2_zh.engelska: Blackjack, straight off the deal. Paid three to two.

blackjack_3_zh.text: 这才叫开门红。黑杰克，三赔二。
blackjack_3_zh.engelska: Now that's how you open a hand. Blackjack, three to two.

dealerblackjack_1_zh.text: 庄家是黑杰克。各位，很抱歉。
dealerblackjack_1_zh.engelska: Dealer has blackjack. I'm sorry, everyone.

dealerblackjack_2_zh.text: 这次是庄家拿到黑杰克。高手也难免遇到。
dealerblackjack_2_zh.engelska: Blackjack for the house this time. It happens to the best of us.

dealerblackjack_3_zh.text: 恐怕我拿到黑杰克了。这一局归庄家。
dealerblackjack_3_zh.engelska: I'm afraid it's blackjack for me. That round goes to the house.

dealerbust_1_zh.text: 庄家爆牌！还在局中的各位都赢了。
dealerbust_1_zh.engelska: Dealer busts! Everyone still in the hand gets paid.

dealerbust_2_zh.text: 我的点数太多了，庄家爆牌。恭喜各位。
dealerbust_2_zh.engelska: Too many for me. The house busts. Congratulations, table.

dealerbust_3_zh.text: 庄家超过二十一点。大家都赢了。
dealerbust_3_zh.engelska: And that's over twenty-one for the dealer. Winners all round.

win_1_zh.engelska: Well played. That hand is yours.

win_2_zh.engelska: You beat me on that one. Congratulations.

win_3_zh.engelska: A winning hand. Paid in full.

push_1_zh.text: 点数相同，平局，您的筹码原数退还。
push_1_zh.engelska: Same total. It's a push, your stake stays with you.

push_2_zh.text: 我们打平了。平局，没有输赢。
push_2_zh.engelska: We're level. A push, nobody wins and nobody loses.

lose_1_zh.engelska: Dealer wins. That one goes to the house.

lose_2_zh.text: 很遗憾，这次不行。庄家赢了。
lose_2_zh.engelska: Not this time, I'm afraid. The house holds.

lose_3_zh.text: 差一点，不过这一局庄家赢了。
lose_3_zh.engelska: Close, but the house has it this round.

peek_1_zh.text: 请稍等，我看一下是不是黑杰克。
peek_1_zh.engelska: One moment while I check for blackjack.

peek_2_zh.text: 庄家检查是否有黑杰克。

peek_3_zh.text: 检查黑杰克。我可没藏牌。
peek_3_zh.engelska: Checking for blackjack. Nothing up my sleeve.

farewell_1_zh.text: 感谢您的光临。很荣幸为您发牌。
farewell_1_zh.engelska: Thank you for playing. It was a pleasure dealing for you.

farewell_2_zh.text: 今晚就到这里吗？谢谢您，很高兴您来到我的牌桌。
farewell_2_zh.engelska: All done for tonight? Thank you, it was lovely having you at the table.

farewell_3_zh.text: 晚安，感谢您今晚的陪伴。
farewell_3_zh.engelska: Good night, and thank you for the company at my table.

chatter1_1_zh.text: 今晚牌桌很安静。我最喜欢这样的夜晚。
chatter1_1_zh.engelska: Quiet night at the table. Those are my favourite.

chatter1_2_zh.text: 八副牌，每一局都重新洗牌。每一手都从零开始。
chatter1_2_zh.engelska: Eight decks, shuffled fresh every round. Every hand starts from nothing.

chatter1_3_zh.text: 我在这张桌上发过很多手牌，从来没有两手是一样的。
chatter1_3_zh.engelska: I've dealt a lot of hands at this table. No two ever play out the same.

chatter2_1_zh.engelska: Take your time. The cards aren't going anywhere.

chatter2_2_zh.text: 一点也不急，您好好想想。
chatter2_2_zh.engelska: No rush at all. Think it over.

chatter2_3_zh.text: 您准备好就行，由您决定。
chatter2_3_zh.engelska: Whenever you're ready. The decision is yours.
